summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Coco Crumble interactive storybook bakery website. Details the visual architecture, expressive SVG mascot with eye-tracking, three interactive games (Cake Chaos, Cake for Your Mood, Cake or Fake), the 6-scene interactive origin story, real configurable n8n chatbot integration, Web Audio API sound effects with mute controls, LocalStorage-backed guestbook and visitor counter, sparkle cursor, Chaos Mode, and hidden Easter egg.
